{"action":"shell","command":"cat > /testbed/specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Batch Journal Writer for TinyDB

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Updated**: 2026-10-17 (re-validated after milestone 2/3 requirement updates)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
  - Note: spec references the public feature surface (BatchWriter, apply, preview, default table, ValueError) because the issue defines the API contract; no storage/algorithm/code-structure details are prescribed.
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-021 each state a concrete observable behavior)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-008 use 100%/zero counts and concrete outcomes)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (User Stories 1-6, 5+ scenarios each)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (16 edge cases incl. bool doc_id, non-list input, token retry after failure, preview detachment)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (default table only; single instance; additive wrapper)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A11; A5 explicitly supersedes milestone-1 extra-keys assumption)

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (apply, rollback, validation, preview, ID continuity, token idempotency)
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- Re-validated 2026-10-17 after merging milestone 2 (R04-R06, R05b, R05 clarification) and milestone 3 (R07-R08) into the spec; all items pass.
- Conflicting older note ("preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted") recorded and resolved in spec Change History: superseded by R04/R05.
- Milestone-1 assumption "extra keys ignored" superseded by R04 strict validation (spec A5); recorded in Change History.
- Residual items to confirm in clarify/plan: A8 (deep equality for "identical batch"), A10 (per-instance token state), A11 (allocator persisted in table state).
EOF
echo OK4"}
